fixed.description: parameter_id -> value, set ONCE before sweeping (constant context)

axes.description: ordered OUTER->INNER; axes[0] is the slowest loop

detectors.description: gettable parameter ids recorded at every point

zigzag.description: serpentine order: reverse inner axes on every other pass

oneOf.title: zip (several params in lockstep = one dimension)
fly (INNERMOST only: one continuous move per row, binned by the measured position)

speed.description: fly speed, in the position's unit per second

speed_param.description: the settable the speed is set on

readback.description: the streamed position to bin by (default: param)

move.description: the stage that flies the row when param is a coordinate measured by something else (camera.laser_x); the grid, placement and binning stay in param's coordinates

lag_correction.description: move each sample back by its channel's declared delay (default true)

timeout_s.description: longest one row may take (default 3x the expected time + 30 s)

oneOf.title: repeat (sets nothing: everything inside it is done num times; any depth, but not inside a fly axis)

mode.description: keep (default): a dimension 'repeat' with coordinate 0..num-1, every repeat in the file; average: the dimension is collapsed to <det> (mean, NaN ignored), <det>_std (sample std; of |z| for complex) and <det>_n (finite repeats). At most one average repeat per scan; not with a fly axis or the resonance window; numeric detectors only

interval_s.description: repeat k of a pass starts no earlier than t0 + k*interval_s (t0 = start of repeat 0)

name.description: dimension name (default 'repeat', or repeat_1, repeat_2, ... when there are several)

when.description: before_scan: after `fixed`, before the first point; after_scan: after the last point, also after an Abort (not after an error)

axis.description: each_sweep / before_axis / after_axis: a DIM name (a raster gives two)

edge.description: each_sweep: before the first point of each sweep (default), or after the last one (not the scan's last)

on_error.description: continue = log the failure and carry on (e.g. an autofocus that finds no peak); default stop

action.description: a name registered in scan_core/hooks.py: call, wait_ms, autofocus, settle_extra

call_args.title: a routine: blocking sets (in order), then one blocking action -- or an ordered list of steps

set.description: settable parameter_id -> value; params the scan already holds are restored afterwards (except at after_scan)

action.description: a registry action id, e.g. vna.take_reference

steps.description: the ordered form: each step sets parameters or runs an action, in the order written; the restore runs once, after the last step

window.title: RESONANCE WINDOW: sweep a slow array detector only around the predicted FMR line (optional; stepped scans only)

detector.description: a 1-D array detector (trace over frequency) whose describe declares `window`

field.description: parameter id whose value at the point is the field B (mT, T, G or Oe)

angle.description: in-plane field angle: a parameter id, or a fixed number in deg (default 0)

margin_MHz.description: half width of the window around the predicted resonance

dip.description: the line is a minimum (transmission dip) or a maximum

track.description: correct Meff from every clean measured line

full_every.description: a full-band sweep every N points (and always at the first); 0 = only the first

call_step.title: one step of a routine: sets (in order), then an optional action
